## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** your project of Online activities 9, 10 and 11 (the
  form, the website, the post and the plan), a phone, and PowerPoint (on a
  computer, on the web at `office.com`, or the phone app).
- **Time:** about 45 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** read Steps 1–3 and answer their questions: the page
  checks each answer at once. Then do the **Tasks to submit**.
- **What you submit:** two links, one PowerPoint file and one letter, on
  the university e-learning platform, one week after practice 2.

## Key terms {.study}

{{< glossary digital-service website marketing-plan >}}

## Step 1 · Check every part {.study}

**In Project Checker:** Sami checks the project of Easy Print, part by
part. Then check your own project in the same way: the form (a test
response arrives in the sheet), the site (published, three pages, the
button opens the form), the post (a free photo and its source) and the
plan (a goal with a number).

{{< sim file="sims/project-checker.html" poster="sims/project-checker.png" title="Project Checker: is every part ready?" height="440" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The checks"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="nothing|delete the site"}
The site opens only on your laptop. What do you do?
:   Publish

    Why: Only a published site opens for everybody.

The goal of the plan is "be famous". What do you write instead?
:   a number and a time, for example 20 orders this month

    Why: A goal with a number can be measured.
:::
:::

## Step 2 · The three slides of the talk {.study}

- **Slide 1** (Title and Content): the name of the service, the customer
  and the need, in three short points.
- **Slide 2** (Two Content): a screenshot of your website, and the link of
  the form.
- **Slide 3** (Two Content): your post, and the goal of your plan.
- One theme for the three slides (Online activity 4 showed how).

::: {.callout-note title="Model · The three slides of the gym"}
Slide 1: *College Gym booking · for students and staff · book a time
without waiting*. Slide 2: a screenshot of the gym site and the form link.
Slide 3: the post *The gym is open · Book now* and the goal *60 bookings
this month*.
:::

**In PowerPoint (the same as in Online activity 4).** The orange numbers
show where to click.

::: {.screens}
![[1]{.step-n} Click **Home › New Slide**. [2]{.step-n} Choose the layout: **Title and Content** for slide 1, **Two Content** for slides 2 and 3.](../week-04/images/ppt-newslide-1.png)

![[1]{.step-n} Click **Insert**, then [2]{.step-n} **Pictures**, then [3]{.step-n} **This Device** for your screenshot and your post.](../week-04/images/ppt-picture-1.png)
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · The slides"}
Choose the right slide.

::: {.match extra="slide 4|no slide"}
The screenshot of your website and the link of the form.
:   slide 2

    Why: Slide 2 shows how the service works.

Your post and the goal of the plan.
:   slide 3

    Why: Slide 3 shows how people hear about the service.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · Say how you used AI {.study}

- If an AI assistant helped you (for example with the words of the post),
  say so: that is honest work.
- Copy this line onto slide 3: *Ideas for the words of the post: an AI
  assistant; checked by me.*
- If you did not use AI, write nothing.

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Honest work"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="hide it|delete the post"}
An AI assistant gave you ideas for your post. What do you do?
:   write the AI-use line on slide 3

    Why: You say how you used AI: honest work.

You did not use AI at all. What do you write?
:   nothing

    Why: The line is only for work done with AI help.
:::
:::
